scenario: Install the anti-slop plugin in a repository that has no existing copy and already depends on oxlint.
acceptanceCriteria: The repository's AGENTS.md and git status are read before any file is written.
@oxlint/plugins is installed at the exact oxlint version from the lockfile.
Existing ignores and rules are kept, and the generic rules are set to error.
UPSTREAM.md records the source identity or states that the revision is unknown.
